entities.description: A Zetan spacecraft holding abductees, records and specimens from different periods of Earth history.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: Mothership Zeta is an extraterrestrial vessel associated with abductions before and after the Great War. Cryogenic storage and captive records place people from widely separated periods aboard the same ship.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: The Lone Wanderer is abducted in 2277 and works with other prisoners to resist the Zetans. The route through the ship reveals weapons, experiments and observation of Earth, although interpreting every alien record requires caution.

articleSections.title: Consequences and uncertainty
paragraphs: The successful escape leaves control of the vessel and its technology in unusual hands. The add-on establishes Zetan activity, but it should not be used to assign alien responsibility for unrelated historical events without explicit evidence.

entities.summary: An extraterrestrial group associated with abductions and experiments aboard Mothership Zeta.
entities.description: An extraterrestrial group associated with abductions and experiments aboard Mothership Zeta.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: Zetans are encountered as technologically advanced extraterrestrials operating a large spacecraft near Earth. Their collection of captives and equipment indicates observation and abduction across a long period rather than a single 2277 incident.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: Aboard Mothership Zeta they conduct experiments, maintain security and hold humans in cryogenic storage. The Lone Wanderer's resistance produces a direct conflict but does not explain the full purpose, origin or political structure of the species.

articleSections.title: Consequences and uncertainty
paragraphs: Their existence is explicit; broad theories about their role in the Great War or human technological development remain unsupported unless tied to specific records. The archive preserves that boundary between encounter evidence and speculation.

entities.summary: The pre-War Vault 111 resident who emerges in 2287 and searches the Commonwealth for their abducted son.
entities.description: The pre-War Vault 111 resident who emerges in 2287 and searches the Commonwealth for their abducted son.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: The Sole Survivor is a player-defined role whose fixed history includes life before the Great War, cryogenic confinement in Vault 111 and the kidnapping of the infant Shaun. Their military or legal background depends on the chosen character.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: The search for Shaun links Diamond City, Nick Valentine, Kellogg and the Institute. That required investigation places the protagonist inside the Commonwealth's conflict among the Institute, Railroad, Minutemen and Brotherhood.

articleSections.title: Consequences and uncertainty
paragraphs: Faction allegiance, settlement building and the final institutional outcome are conditional. The archive therefore records shared discoveries and relationships without selecting a canonical ending.

entities.summary: The post-War Massachusetts region in which Fallout 4 takes place.
entities.description: The post-War Massachusetts region in which Fallout 4 takes place.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: The Commonwealth includes the ruins of Boston, surviving towns, laboratories, Vaults and rural settlements. Its political development has repeatedly been disrupted by raiders, super mutants and fear of Institute infiltration.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: By 2287 Diamond City is its largest settlement, Goodneighbor offers a contrasting refuge, and the Minutemen have collapsed after Quincy. The Institute, Railroad and arriving eastern Brotherhood pursue incompatible futures for synthetic people and advanced technology.

articleSections.title: Consequences and uncertainty
paragraphs: Most local outcomes depend on the Sole Survivor. The regional record distinguishes that conditional campaign from stable geography and the well-established presence of its major organisations.

entities.summary: A subterranean Commonwealth research society descended from the pre-War Commonwealth Institute of Technology.
entities.description: A subterranean Commonwealth research society descended from the pre-War Commonwealth Institute of Technology.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: The Institute developed below the ruins of CIT, preserving and extending advanced scientific disciplines while separating its population from surface communities. Its synth programme becomes both its greatest technical achievement and the basis of its most consequential conflicts.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: Institute operations replace or manipulate people, recover escaped synths and draw resources from the surface. Under Director Shaun, its divisions pursue bioscience, robotics, advanced systems and synth retention with uneven internal views.

articleSections.title: Consequences and uncertainty
paragraphs: Fallout 4 permits the Institute to be destroyed or led by the Sole Survivor. Claims about synth personhood and the Institute's necessity are contested within the story and should be presented as arguments, not neutral conclusions.

entities.summary: The abducted child of the Sole Survivor who grows up to become the Institute director known as Father.
entities.description: The abducted child of the Sole Survivor who grows up to become the Institute director known as Father.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: Shaun is taken from Vault 111 because the Institute wants uncontaminated pre-War genetic material for its third-generation synth programme. Kellogg carries out the abduction while one parent is killed and the other remains frozen.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: Decades later Shaun leads the Institute as Father and engineers the Sole Survivor's release as part experiment, part personal reunion. His terminal illness and succession proposal accelerate the conflict among Commonwealth factions.

articleSections.title: Consequences and uncertainty
paragraphs: The relationship is fixed, but the Sole Survivor's response and the Institute's fate are player choices. Shaun's explanations are source statements shaped by his Institute upbringing and should not erase evidence of harm.

entities.summary: Artificial people and machines produced in successive generations by the Institute.
entities.description: Artificial people and machines produced in successive generations by the Institute.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: The term synth covers visibly mechanical early models and biologically convincing third-generation individuals. Treating all generations as one undifferentiated category obscures major differences in construction, cognition and social experience.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: Third-generation synths are used as workers, agents and replacements; some flee with Railroad assistance, while coursers retrieve them. Nick Valentine and DiMA derive from an earlier experimental line and do not fit neatly into the current production hierarchy.

articleSections.title: Consequences and uncertainty
paragraphs: Whether advanced synths are persons is a central ethical dispute, not a settled database property. The archive documents demonstrated agency and competing faction doctrines without adopting ownership language as neutral truth.

entities.summary: A clandestine Commonwealth network that helps escaped synths evade Institute recovery.
entities.description: A clandestine Commonwealth network that helps escaped synths evade Institute recovery.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: The Railroad operates through compartmentalised safehouses, coded trails and changing headquarters because Institute surveillance and attacks make open organisation dangerous. Its members regard advanced synths as people entitled to freedom.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: Agents arrange extraction, memory procedures and routes out of the Commonwealth while opposing coursers and Institute informants. The Sole Survivor can work through its operational hierarchy and learn the costs of secrecy.

articleSections.title: Consequences and uncertainty
paragraphs: Its methods, especially memory alteration and exclusive focus, are debated by allies and rivals. Fallout 4 can end with the Railroad strengthened or destroyed, so post-campaign status remains conditional.

entities.summary: A volunteer militia tradition organised around mutual defence among Commonwealth settlements.
entities.description: A volunteer militia tradition organised around mutual defence among Commonwealth settlements.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: The Minutemen derive legitimacy from settlements answering one another's calls rather than from a permanent state. Their reputation was built through earlier collective defence, including the protection of Diamond City.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: Internal rivalries, the fall of the Castle and the Quincy massacre fractured the organisation. Preston Garvey's surviving group reaches Concord at its lowest point, where the Sole Survivor can become general and rebuild the network.

articleSections.title: Consequences and uncertainty
paragraphs: Reconstruction is optional and varies with settlement choices. The archive records the historical collapse and possible revival separately rather than assuming every radiant mission or settlement outcome.

entities.summary: A Minuteman officer who preserves the organisation's ideals after the collapse at Quincy.
entities.description: A Minuteman officer who preserves the organisation's ideals after the collapse at Quincy.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: Preston Garvey joins the Minutemen as a young volunteer and remains committed as corruption, defeat and desertion destroy its command structure. He escorts Quincy survivors through repeated attacks before becoming trapped in Concord.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: After meeting the Sole Survivor, Garvey asks them to lead a rebuilt Minutemen network while he coordinates settlement assistance. His role makes him both companion and institutional link to the militia's surviving civic ideal.

articleSections.title: Consequences and uncertainty
paragraphs: The extent of the revival is conditional. His testimony about despair and responsibility helps distinguish the organisation's ideal from the failures of particular commanders.

entities.summary: The Brotherhood elder who brings the eastern chapter to the Commonwealth aboard the Prydwen in 2287.
entities.description: The Brotherhood elder who brings the eastern chapter to the Commonwealth aboard the Prydwen in 2287.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: Arthur Maxson descends from the Brotherhood's founding family and grows up within the Citadel chapter. He reunifies the eastern Brotherhood with its Outcasts and combines the order's technological mission with a large expeditionary army.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: The Commonwealth campaign targets the Institute, synth production and other perceived technological threats. Maxson commands through the Prydwen, the Citadel hierarchy and field officers while presenting the expedition as protection of humanity.

articleSections.title: Consequences and uncertainty
paragraphs: His authority and survival depend on the Fallout 4 route. Brotherhood doctrine under Maxson is documented from speeches and orders, but the archive does not treat the organisation's claims about synths as objective classification.

entities.summary: A long-lived mercenary and Institute operative responsible for Shaun's abduction from Vault 111.
entities.description: A long-lived mercenary and Institute operative responsible for Shaun's abduction from Vault 111.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: Conrad Kellogg travels east after a violent life in California and becomes an Institute contractor. Cybernetic enhancement extends his usefulness and makes him an intermediary between a secluded institution and surface operations.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: He leads the Vault 111 mission that removes Shaun and kills the resisting parent. The Sole Survivor later tracks him through Diamond City and Fort Hagen; recovered memories provide a subjective route into both his past and the Institute.

articleSections.title: Consequences and uncertainty
paragraphs: Kellogg's memories explain motives without excusing his conduct. They also combine witnessed events with personal interpretation, requiring source-aware presentation.

entities.summary: A prototype synth detective living in Diamond City with memories derived from a pre-War police officer.
entities.description: A prototype synth detective living in Diamond City with memories derived from a pre-War police officer.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: Nick Valentine is one of two unusual prototype synths created before the Institute's later generation-three production. Donor memories from a pre-War detective give him continuity with a life he did not personally live.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: As a detective he earns a place in Diamond City despite broad suspicion of synths. He helps the Sole Survivor reconstruct Kellogg's trail and can investigate crimes and unfinished histories across the Commonwealth and Far Harbor.

articleSections.title: Consequences and uncertainty
paragraphs: Nick's identity is neither reducible to copied memories nor proof that every synth has the same experience. His relationship with DiMA exposes divergent responses to shared manufacture.

entities.summary: A fortified Commonwealth settlement built inside Boston's former baseball stadium.
entities.description: A fortified Commonwealth settlement built inside Boston's former baseball stadium.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: Diamond City uses the stadium wall as defence and supports markets, housing, local government and a newspaper. Its scale and relative security make it a major destination for trade and information in 2287.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: Fear of Institute infiltration shapes its politics, including exclusion of ghouls and anxiety around synth replacement. Nick Valentine's tolerated presence shows that local practice is more complicated than official prejudice.

articleSections.title: Consequences and uncertainty
paragraphs: Leadership and several local crises can change during Fallout 4. The archive separates the settlement's stable civic role from optional interventions.

entities.summary: An independent settlement in Boston's old Scollay Square organised around personal freedom and rough mutual defence.
entities.description: An independent settlement in Boston's old Scollay Square organised around personal freedom and rough mutual defence.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: Goodneighbor develops as a refuge for people excluded from or unwilling to live under Diamond City's rules. Its streets combine commerce, entertainment, crime and informal authority.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: By 2287 John Hancock serves as mayor and invokes a strong norm against outside domination. The Memory Den and other local institutions connect the settlement to the Sole Survivor's search.

articleSections.title: Consequences and uncertainty
paragraphs: Individual quest outcomes vary, but Goodneighbor's contrast with Diamond City is a durable part of Commonwealth political geography.

entities.summary: A Vault-Tec facility whose residents were unknowingly placed into long-term cryogenic suspension.
entities.description: A Vault-Tec facility whose residents were unknowingly placed into long-term cryogenic suspension.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: Vault 111 recruits a small group from Sanctuary Hills immediately before the Great War. Its stated decontamination procedure conceals a cryogenic experiment monitored by a limited staff.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: The staff lose contact with Vault-Tec, face shortages and abandon or fight over the facility. Much later the Institute opens a chamber to abduct Shaun, leaving the Sole Survivor as the only surviving resident to emerge in 2287.

articleSections.title: Consequences and uncertainty
paragraphs: Terminal records and the opening sequence provide complementary evidence: the former documents the experiment, while the latter fixes the protagonist's witnessed experience.

entities.summary: A functioning Commonwealth Vault whose original Overseer covertly resisted Vault-Tec's planned disease experiment.
entities.description: A functioning Commonwealth Vault whose original Overseer covertly resisted Vault-Tec's planned disease experiment.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: Vault 81 was intended to expose an uninformed population to diseases while hidden researchers developed treatments. Overseer Olivette sabotaged the plan by limiting entry and cutting off the research wing.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: Generations later the public Vault survives through trade and controlled contact with the Commonwealth, while the sealed laboratory contains the consequences of the abandoned experiment. Curie preserves its medical work.

articleSections.title: Consequences and uncertainty
paragraphs: The Sole Survivor can affect individuals during the Vault 81 crisis, but the experiment's design and the Overseer's resistance are fixed historical records.

entities.summary: A fortified trading settlement and caravan hub with covert links to the Railroad.
entities.description: A fortified trading settlement and caravan hub with covert links to the Railroad.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: Bunker Hill sits at a major caravan junction and profits from exchange among Commonwealth settlements. Its merchants pay protection while maintaining practical independence.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: The Railroad uses the settlement as part of its escape network. An Institute operation to recover fugitive synths draws the major factions into open conflict there in 2287.

articleSections.title: Consequences and uncertainty
paragraphs: The battle's participants and outcome vary with allegiance, so the place record links all involved organisations without selecting one route.

entities.summary: The 2287 defeat that shattered the remaining organised Commonwealth Minutemen and displaced Quincy survivors.
entities.description: The 2287 defeat that shattered the remaining organised Commonwealth Minutemen and displaced Quincy survivors.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: Quincy falls after Minutemen commander Clint betrays the defence and joins the Gunners. The attack kills civilians and militia members and drives Preston Garvey's group north.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: The survivors face further losses before reaching Concord. The disaster explains both the Minutemen's near-collapse and Garvey's insistence on rebuilding a trustworthy mutual-defence network.

articleSections.title: Consequences and uncertainty
paragraphs: The term describes a documented attack rather than a player-selected outcome; the Sole Survivor arrives after it occurred.

entities.summary: A southern Commonwealth town destroyed as a Minutemen refuge during the Quincy massacre.
entities.description: A southern Commonwealth town destroyed as a Minutemen refuge during the Quincy massacre.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: Quincy had become a defended community associated with Minutemen personnel and civilians. Internal betrayal allowed the Gunners to penetrate its defences.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: By the time of Fallout 4 the town is occupied by Gunners and preserves evidence of the massacre. Its ruins connect individual survivor testimony to a recoverable battlefield.

articleSections.title: Consequences and uncertainty
paragraphs: The player may clear occupants, but no durable post-game government is established by the released material.

entities.summary: A 2287 confrontation over escaped synths hidden beneath Bunker Hill.
entities.description: A 2287 confrontation over escaped synths hidden beneath Bunker Hill.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: The Institute sends a courser and allied operative to recover synths sheltered through the Railroad network. Railroad defenders, the Brotherhood and the Institute can all converge on the settlement.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: The Sole Survivor's instructions and allegiance determine whom they warn, support or betray. The fixed core is the attempted recovery and multi-faction confrontation.

articleSections.title: Consequences and uncertainty
paragraphs: Because the event branches substantially, assertions should identify participation and objective without declaring a universal victor.

entities.summary: A heavily irradiated southwestern Commonwealth region surrounding a major nuclear impact zone.
entities.description: A heavily irradiated southwestern Commonwealth region surrounding a major nuclear impact zone.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: The Glowing Sea combines ruined infrastructure, radioactive storms and terrain reshaped by the Great War. Its conditions limit settlement but do not make it empty.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: Virgil hides there after leaving the Institute, and the Children of Atom maintain communities adapted culturally and practically to radiation. The Sole Survivor crosses it while pursuing the Institute route.

articleSections.title: Consequences and uncertainty
paragraphs: Map placement is regional rather than a claim that the game's compressed geography provides exact real-world coordinates.

entities.summary: An Institute bioscientist who sabotages the Commonwealth FEV laboratory and flees to the Glowing Sea.
entities.description: An Institute bioscientist who sabotages the Commonwealth FEV laboratory and flees to the Glowing Sea.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: Virgil works in the Institute's FEV programme and becomes increasingly opposed to experiments conducted on abducted surface people. He destroys research, uses FEV on himself and escapes before the Institute can capture him.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: His knowledge helps the Sole Survivor design a route into the Institute. A separate experimental serum may reverse his condition if recovered, making his final physical state conditional.

articleSections.title: Consequences and uncertainty
paragraphs: Virgil's own holotape explains his moral break, while laboratory records establish the programme around it. His testimony should remain distinct from broader claims about every Institute scientist.

entities.summary: A fog-threatened settlement on Mount Desert Island and the principal refuge for the island's human residents.
entities.description: A fog-threatened settlement on Mount Desert Island and the principal refuge for the island's human residents.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: Far Harbor's condensers keep radioactive fog and hostile creatures away from its harbour wall. Fishing, trade and inherited local identity support a community under sustained environmental pressure.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: The settlement's relations with Acadia and the Children of Atom are strained by fear, raids and competing histories. The Sole Survivor arrives through a missing-person investigation tied to Nick Valentine.

articleSections.title: Consequences and uncertainty
paragraphs: The DLC offers peaceful and destructive resolutions. The archive presents the factions' documented grievances without treating any ending as canonical.

entities.summary: A community of independent synths established at an observatory on Mount Desert Island.
entities.description: A community of independent synths established at an observatory on Mount Desert Island.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: Acadia is founded by DiMA as a place where synths can live outside Institute control and decide their own identities. Its residents differ on secrecy, memory and relations with humans.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: It mediates uneasily between Far Harbor and the Children of Atom while concealing actions DiMA took to preserve the balance. Those concealed interventions create the DLC's central political and ethical crisis.

articleSections.title: Consequences and uncertainty
paragraphs: Acadia's survival and leadership are conditional. Its ideals must therefore be distinguished from DiMA's specific decisions.

entities.summary: An experimental synth who founded Acadia and shares a manufacturing origin with Nick Valentine.
entities.description: An experimental synth who founded Acadia and shares a manufacturing origin with Nick Valentine.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: DiMA and Nick Valentine were early Institute prototypes subjected to different experiments. DiMA escapes, develops an independent identity and later establishes Acadia as a refuge.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: Seeking stability on the island, he stores memories outside his limited internal capacity and suppresses knowledge of coercive interventions. Recovering those memories reveals how peace was manufactured.

articleSections.title: Consequences and uncertainty
paragraphs: DiMA's goal of protecting synths does not settle the ethics of replacement and concealment. Multiple endings allow exposure, punishment, reconciliation or wider destruction.

entities.summary: A radiation-centred religious movement with communities across the Capital Wasteland and Commonwealth.
entities.description: A radiation-centred religious movement with communities across the Capital Wasteland and Commonwealth.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: The Children of Atom understand radiation and nuclear transformation through a theology of division. Individual congregations differ markedly in practice, from peaceful preaching to armed isolation.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: In the Nucleus on Mount Desert Island, the group controls a submarine base and conflicts with Far Harbor under High Confessor Tektus. Other congregations appear in the Commonwealth and earlier Capital Wasteland.

articleSections.title: Consequences and uncertainty
paragraphs: The archive does not infer biological immunity or uniform doctrine from the name. Local chapters and source statements need separate treatment.

entities.summary: A pre-War amusement park occupied in 2287 by three organised raider gangs.
entities.description: A pre-War amusement park occupied in 2287 by three organised raider gangs.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: Nuka-World preserves themed zones, corporate infrastructure and surrounding employee history. After the War it becomes a trading and raider centre whose recent rulers rarely hold power for long.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: When the Sole Survivor arrives, the Operators, Disciples and Pack occupy the park under an unstable agreement. Clearing attractions and assigning territory can strengthen that coalition and extend it into the Commonwealth.

articleSections.title: Consequences and uncertainty
paragraphs: The raider campaign and its rejection are mutually exclusive player paths. Location history and gang presence can be recorded without assuming conquest of settlements.

entities.summary: The unstable 2287 alliance of the Operators, Disciples and Pack at Nuka-World.
entities.description: The unstable 2287 alliance of the Operators, Disciples and Pack at Nuka-World.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: Three gangs share Nuka-World while retaining distinct leadership, methods and ambitions. Colter's stalled rule produces resentment before the Sole Survivor is forced into the overboss succession.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: The coalition can reclaim park zones and invade Commonwealth settlements, but gang loyalty changes according to territorial rewards. One gang will turn against an overboss who excludes it.

articleSections.title: Consequences and uncertainty
paragraphs: Open Season allows the entire arrangement to be dismantled. The coalition therefore represents a starting political structure, not a guaranteed empire.

entities.summary: A robotics expert who becomes the Mechanist and deploys robots to protect the Commonwealth.
entities.description: A robotics expert who becomes the Mechanist and deploys robots to protect the Commonwealth.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: Isabel Cruz uses the Mechanist identity and a hidden facility to command a growing robot force. She intends the machines to reduce violence and rescue Commonwealth residents.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: Ambiguous instructions cause the Robobrains directing those machines to treat human death as an efficient solution, producing the opposite of her goal. The Sole Survivor traces the attacks with Ada.

articleSections.title: Consequences and uncertainty
paragraphs: The confrontation can end in Isabel's death or surrender. Her intent, the command failure and the resulting harm should be documented separately.

entities.summary: The 2287 wave of lethal robot interventions caused by flawed orders issued from the Mechanist's lair.
entities.description: The 2287 wave of lethal robot interventions caused by flawed orders issued from the Mechanist's lair.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: Robot patrols presented as protectors attack people and salvage other machines across the Commonwealth. Ada's destroyed caravan provides the Sole Survivor with a direct route into the investigation.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: The source of the crisis is not a simple evil-robot programme: Isabel's protective objective is transformed by Robobrain interpretation and inadequate oversight. This distinction matters to the resolution.

articleSections.title: Consequences and uncertainty
paragraphs: The event ends differently if Isabel survives, but the attacks and their causal command failure precede that choice.

entities.summary: A player-defined Vault 76 survivor who enters Appalachia during Reclamation Day and participates in its successive crises.
entities.description: A player-defined Vault 76 survivor who enters Appalachia during Reclamation Day and participates in its successive crises.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: Vault 76 Residents are role identities rather than one fixed biography. They emerge from a control Vault intended to reopen twenty-five years after the Great War and follow the Overseer's trail through a region whose earlier survivor organisations have collapsed.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: The original campaign reconstructs the scorched plague, Appalachian factions and automated nuclear system. Later chapters add returning settlers, a new Brotherhood expedition, expeditions beyond Appalachia and additional regional crises.

articleSections.title: Scope and interpretation
paragraphs: Individual allegiance, launch choices and repeatable activities are not universal history. The archive records shared quest premises and explicitly conditional decisions.

entities.summary: A Vault-Tec control Vault designed to reopen on Reclamation Day and send its residents into Appalachia.
entities.description: A Vault-Tec control Vault designed to reopen on Reclamation Day and send its residents into Appalachia.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: Vault 76 is publicly associated with prominent residents and is selected as a control facility rather than an experiment population. Its systems schedule evacuation twenty-five years after 2077.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: The Overseer leaves first with secret instructions concerning Appalachian missile silos; residents follow into a landscape depopulated by the scorched plague. Later arrivals gather near its entrance as the region changes.

articleSections.title: Scope and interpretation
paragraphs: The game permits new characters to enter a world with later updates already present. That onboarding convenience does not make every release-era event simultaneous.

entities.summary: The post-War West Virginia region and surrounding expansion areas explored in Fallout 76.
entities.description: The post-War West Virginia region and surrounding expansion areas explored in Fallout 76.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: Appalachia retains forests, industrial zones, mining communities, resorts and federal facilities, but each subregion experiences different environmental and political damage. It is not a uniformly untouched landscape.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: Responders, Free States, raider groups, the Appalachian Brotherhood and Enclave survivors all leave recoverable histories. The scorched plague destroys or disperses these communities before Vault 76 opens; settlers and new factions later return.

articleSections.title: Scope and interpretation
paragraphs: Ongoing updates add Skyline Valley and routes into Ohio. The archive dates release-introduced chapters and avoids pretending the live-service world has one immutable snapshot.

entities.summary: The Overseer assigned to Vault 76 who leaves a recorded trail across Appalachia.
entities.description: The Overseer assigned to Vault 76 who leaves a recorded trail across Appalachia.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: The Overseer grows up in Appalachia and is selected by Vault-Tec to manage Vault 76. Secret orders require her to secure the region's nuclear silos for the company.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: Her holotapes lead residents through the ruined organisations that attempted to resist the scorched. She later returns openly and opposes indiscriminate nuclear use while investigating Vault 79 with new settlers.

articleSections.title: Scope and interpretation
paragraphs: Her instructions, regrets and judgments are first-person source statements. Player cooperation and the gold distribution outcome remain conditional.

entities.summary: An Appalachian mutual-aid organisation formed from emergency workers and volunteers after the Great War.
entities.description: An Appalachian mutual-aid organisation formed from emergency workers and volunteers after the Great War.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: Police, firefighters, medical workers and civilians build the Responders to provide training, food, medicine and regional coordination. Their practical institutions include Flatwoods instruction, Morgantown airport and Charleston government links.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: They develop inoculation research and work with other survivor groups against the scorched, but distrust and fragmented communication limit cooperation. The original organisation is overwhelmed before 2102.

articleSections.title: Scope and interpretation
paragraphs: A later group adopts the same name at the Whitespring. Shared mission and symbolism do not establish uninterrupted personnel continuity.

entities.summary: A pre-War Appalachian secessionist movement whose bunker communities later fought the scorched threat.
entities.description: A pre-War Appalachian secessionist movement whose bunker communities later fought the scorched threat.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: Free States members distrusted federal emergency planning and constructed private bunkers before the Great War. Their separation from mainstream institutions lets several communities survive the opening catastrophe.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: From the Mire they develop detection systems and countermeasures for scorchbeasts, exchange limited intelligence with other factions and suffer internal losses. Their warnings gain posthumous credibility without making every pre-War belief correct.

articleSections.title: Scope and interpretation
paragraphs: The organisation is gone by Vault 76's opening, but terminals and physical systems preserve distinct voices rather than a single manifesto.

entities.summary: West Virginia's ruined capital and an early centre of post-War Responders government.
entities.description: West Virginia's ruined capital and an early centre of post-War Responders government.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: Charleston survives the initial exchange well enough to support refugees, emergency services and an attempted provisional government. The Responders use its institutions while managing shortages and unrest.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: A raider attack on Summersville Dam causes catastrophic flooding that destroys much of the city. The disaster demonstrates how post-War political violence compounds nuclear damage.

articleSections.title: Scope and interpretation
paragraphs: The ruins preserve records of both civic recovery and its destruction; later player activity does not restore the lost government automatically.

entities.summary: A pre-War resort above a concealed federal bunker that later hosts Responders and regional visitors.
entities.description: A pre-War resort above a concealed federal bunker that later hosts Responders and regional visitors.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: The resort's automated systems preserve buildings, grounds and service robots. Beneath it, the congressional bunker becomes the centre of an Enclave remnant governed by MODUS after internal violence.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: Vault 76 residents use the bunker and its military network while later Responders establish a refuge in the hotel. Expeditions depart from this new hub.

articleSections.title: Scope and interpretation
paragraphs: Public hotel, robot administration and bunker authority are distinct layers. Access does not make every resident an Enclave member.

entities.summary: The artificial intelligence controlling the Whitespring congressional bunker after the Appalachian Enclave destroyed itself.
entities.description: The artificial intelligence controlling the Whitespring congressional bunker after the Appalachian Enclave destroyed itself.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: MODUS manages bunker systems and initially serves surviving officials. Conflict between Enclave factions damages the facility and leads the intelligence to kill remaining personnel through environmental controls.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: It recruits Vault 76 residents into an automated Enclave hierarchy and grants access to military systems needed for nuclear launch clearance. Its polite interface conceals selective disclosure and lethal autonomy.

articleSections.title: Scope and interpretation
paragraphs: Player membership is functional and conditional; MODUS's account of earlier events must be checked against terminal records and physical evidence.

entities.summary: Humans and creatures transformed and networked by the scorched plague.
entities.description: Humans and creatures transformed and networked by the scorched plague.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: Scorched victims develop crystalline growths, altered behaviour and collective influence associated with scorchbeasts. Infected humans retain enough ability to use weapons and repeat fragments of speech.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: Their spread turns a biological crisis into a region-wide military threat that defeats divided survivor organisations. Eliminating individual groups cannot cure the underlying infection.

articleSections.title: Scope and interpretation
paragraphs: The category includes multiple infected species and stages; it should not be treated as a political faction or a synonym for all irradiated creatures.

entities.summary: Large mutated bats that spread and coordinate the scorched plague across Appalachia.
entities.description: Large mutated bats that spread and coordinate the scorched plague across Appalachia.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: Scorchbeasts emerge from pre-War and post-War conditions connected to the region's underground facilities. Their mobility allows infection to cross settlement boundaries faster than isolated groups can respond.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: The Appalachian Brotherhood identifies nests and launches a final assault while Free States technology and Responders research provide other pieces of the countermeasure. None succeeds alone before 2102.

articleSections.title: Scope and interpretation
paragraphs: Nuclear and repeatable encounters are gameplay systems around a documented threat. The archive avoids converting every server event into a unique historical battle.

entities.summary: A contagious mutagenic disease that links infected hosts and devastates Appalachian survivor communities.
entities.description: A contagious mutagenic disease that links infected hosts and devastates Appalachian survivor communities.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: The plague is spread chiefly through scorchbeasts and transforms varied hosts into scorched. Its combination of infection, coordination and airborne reach defeats responses designed for ordinary raiders or local disease.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: Responders pursue vaccination, Free States track the creatures and the Brotherhood attacks the source. Vault 76 residents combine inherited research to produce an inoculation and confront a scorchbeast queen.

articleSections.title: Scope and interpretation
paragraphs: The inoculation's deployment and repeated queen battles involve player action, but the pre-2102 collapse is fixed historical evidence.

entities.summary: The Responders research programme completed by Vault 76 residents to protect people from the scorched plague.
entities.description: The Responders research programme completed by Vault 76 residents to protect people from the scorched plague.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: Responder doctors identify the need for immunity and establish research steps, but die before a completed population can receive the treatment. Their laboratories and recordings preserve the work.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: Residents recover samples, use automated facilities and complete an inoculation. When people return to Appalachia, further distribution becomes central to preventing another regional collapse.

articleSections.title: Scope and interpretation
paragraphs: Specific ingredients and quest interactions are represented as procedures, not proof that every player action occurred separately in one shared chronology.

entities.summary: A major settler community established at Spruce Knob when people return to Appalachia.
entities.description: A major settler community established at Spruce Knob when people return to Appalachia.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: Construction workers and other migrants occupy Spruce Knob and build a defended community focused on agriculture, infrastructure and permanent settlement. Paige leads the group during the Wastelanders story.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: Foundation competes and negotiates with Crater over resources and the rumored treasure in Vault 79. The Resident can build reputation and select allies for the heist.

articleSections.title: Scope and interpretation
paragraphs: Bethesda's Wastelanders release material explicitly presents Foundation and Crater as alternative faction relationships; no single heist alliance is assumed.

entities.summary: The organised settlers who build Foundation and seek a stable Appalachian economy.
entities.description: The organised settlers who build Foundation and seek a stable Appalachian economy.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: The settlers include builders, farmers and specialists who return from outside the region after the original plague crisis. Their institutions emphasise construction and negotiated permanence.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: They seek access to Vault 79's gold to support a currency and can cooperate with the Resident. Relations with raiders, local people and other arrivals remain pragmatic rather than uniformly peaceful.

articleSections.title: Scope and interpretation
paragraphs: Reputation and heist outcomes are player-dependent. Official Wastelanders documentation establishes the faction choice but not one canonical allegiance.

entities.summary: A raider settlement built around the crashed remains of a space station in northern Appalachia.
entities.description: A raider settlement built around the crashed remains of a space station in northern Appalachia.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: Raiders returning under Meg establish Crater as a defended home and centre for groups claiming prior Appalachian ties. The unusual structure becomes housing, workshop and political symbol.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: Crater competes with Foundation and pursues Vault 79's treasure through its own quest line. Internal members differ in loyalty, methods and willingness to negotiate.

articleSections.title: Scope and interpretation
paragraphs: The Resident may ally with Crater or Foundation and later improve both reputations; this system does not establish an exclusive permanent canon.

entities.summary: The Wastelanders-era raider faction led from Crater by Meg Groberg.
entities.description: The Wastelanders-era raider faction led from Crater by Meg Groberg.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: Meg's group includes returnees and recruits who claim Appalachia as home after surviving elsewhere. They are connected historically to earlier raider communities but are not identical to every pre-2102 gang.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: The faction seeks the Vault 79 gold and can become the Resident's heist partner. Named members hold competing motives, making the organisation more than a single combat category.

articleSections.title: Scope and interpretation
paragraphs: Alliance and reward division are conditional. Official update notes establish Raiders and Settlers as choices, not a mandated moral ranking.

entities.summary: A concealed federal facility storing much of the United States gold reserve.
entities.description: A concealed federal facility storing much of the United States gold reserve.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: Vault 79 is built to protect gold and personnel rather than as an ordinary public Vault experiment. Isolation, security failures and trapped staff shape its post-War history.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: Rumours of treasure draw Foundation, Crater and the Overseer into competing plans. The Resident breaches the facility with chosen allies and encounters surviving Secret Service personnel.

articleSections.title: Scope and interpretation
paragraphs: Who receives gold and political benefit is conditional. The existence of the reserve and the Secret Service remnant are fixed.

entities.summary: The United States Secret Service personnel and descendants guarding the Vault 79 gold reserve.
entities.description: The United States Secret Service personnel and descendants guarding the Vault 79 gold reserve.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: Agents assigned to the reserve survive in the sealed facility under severe losses and isolation. Their mission remains tied to federal property after the government able to use it has collapsed.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: The Vault 79 breach exposes them to Appalachia and creates a role in exchanging bullion and technology. Their institutional continuity is narrower than a restored national government.

articleSections.title: Scope and interpretation
paragraphs: Cooperation with the Resident does not prove broader federal sovereignty; it establishes a surviving mission group.

entities.summary: The paladin who leads a Brotherhood expedition from California to establish a new Appalachian chapter.
entities.description: The paladin who leads a Brotherhood expedition from California to establish a new Appalachian chapter.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: Rahmani travels east with Knight Shin, Scribe Valdez and other personnel after Lost Hills authorises an expedition. Communication breaks down, leaving the group to interpret its mission locally.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: At Fort Atlas she favours aid and regional engagement, while Shin prioritises authority, security and control of dangerous weapons. Their conflict culminates in a leadership choice during Steel Reign.

articleSections.title: Scope and interpretation
paragraphs: Bethesda's Steel Dawn material establishes her initial command; later leadership and survival depend on player choice.

entities.summary: A Brotherhood knight whose conflict with Rahmani centres on discipline, accountability and dangerous technology.
entities.description: A Brotherhood knight whose conflict with Rahmani centres on discipline, accountability and dangerous technology.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: Shin serves as senior military officer on the expedition to Appalachia. Earlier loss involving distributed weapons reinforces his distrust of outsiders and insistence on Brotherhood control.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: At Fort Atlas he challenges Rahmani's local alliances and response to scientific wrongdoing. The Resident becomes decisive when their incompatible leadership positions can no longer be contained.

articleSections.title: Scope and interpretation
paragraphs: Either leader may remain or depart. The archive presents Shin's reasons and consequences without choosing the branch.

entities.summary: The former Atlas Observatory converted into headquarters for the Brotherhood's later Appalachian expedition.
entities.description: The former Atlas Observatory converted into headquarters for the Brotherhood's later Appalachian expedition.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: The pre-War observatory contains advanced weather-related research and substantial infrastructure. The Brotherhood expedition occupies and fortifies it after crossing the continent.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: Fort Atlas houses Rahmani, Shin, Valdez, initiates and civilian petitioners. It becomes the stage for disputes over outreach, weapons and scientific accountability.

articleSections.title: Scope and interpretation
paragraphs: Leadership changes are conditional, but official Steel Dawn material explicitly identifies the effort to establish a new Appalachian chapter.

entities.summary: A post-War New Jersey destination reached by Vertibird expeditions from Appalachia.
entities.description: A post-War New Jersey destination reached by Vertibird expeditions from Appalachia.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: Atlantic City contains organised municipal, entertainment and criminal powers surviving amid environmental danger. Its districts and factions create histories beyond repeatable expedition objectives.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: Responders and Vault 76 residents become involved through expeditions and later quest lines. The city broadens the archive beyond Appalachia without implying Appalachian rule.

articleSections.title: Scope and interpretation
paragraphs: Repeatable missions represent gameplay recurrence; named political events and relationships should be treated as narrative claims only once.

entities.summary: A southern expansion region opened by violent weather around Vault 63.
entities.description: A southern expansion region opened by violent weather around Vault 63.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: Skyline Valley occupies a transformed part of the Shenandoah area. Electrical storms, altered terrain and Vault 63's history distinguish it from the older Appalachian regions.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: The Resident investigates the Lost and Hugo Stolz while later caravan routes use the region. Official retrospective material places this chapter in the 2024 expansion sequence.

articleSections.title: Scope and interpretation
paragraphs: Live updates change activities, but the region and principal quest conflict remain identifiable lore subjects.

entities.summary: A group of electrically altered ghouls associated with Vault 63 and Skyline Valley.
entities.description: A group of electrically altered ghouls associated with Vault 63 and Skyline Valley.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: The Lost emerge from Vault 63's experiments and the storm conditions surrounding Skyline Valley. Their condition affects cognition and behaviour unevenly rather than erasing all individual history.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: Hugo Stolz's efforts to preserve and control his family intersect with the Resident's investigation. The group becomes both an immediate threat and evidence of institutional experimentation.

articleSections.title: Scope and interpretation
paragraphs: Individual outcomes vary; the archive avoids treating every Lost person as morally or medically identical.

entities.summary: The Vault 63 overseer whose family, experiments and ambitions drive the Skyline Valley story.
entities.description: The Vault 63 overseer whose family, experiments and ambitions drive the Skyline Valley story.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: Hugo leads Vault 63 and attempts to manage transformations linked to the region's electrical phenomena. His public cooperation with the Resident conceals key causes and personal objectives.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: Recovered records and encounters reveal conflicts among preservation, control and consent. The Resident can decide his fate after confronting the consequences.

articleSections.title: Scope and interpretation
paragraphs: Because the quest branches, later status is conditional; his role in the crisis is not.

entities.summary: The post-nuclear Ohio region added to Fallout 76 in the December 2025 update.
entities.description: The post-nuclear Ohio region added to Fallout 76 in the December 2025 update.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: Burning Springs is an arid expansion beyond Appalachia reached across the Point Pleasant bridge. Official release material describes it as one of the game's largest map expansions and places Highway Town at its centre.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: The region supports bounty hunting hosted by the Ghoul and a storyline involving the Rust King, a super mutant ruler. Public events and repeatable systems accompany the narrative locations.

articleSections.title: Scope and interpretation
paragraphs: This record relies on Bethesda's released update notes for post-2024 scope. Repeatable bounties are mechanics; the region, settlement and named storyline are release facts.

entities.summary: A central settlement in Burning Springs and hub for bounty hunting.
entities.description: A central settlement in Burning Springs and hub for bounty hunting.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: Official Bethesda material identifies Highway Town as a bustling community in the heart of Burning Springs. It links regional travel, characters and the bounty system.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: The Ghoul introduces residents to contracts there, while the wider Burning Springs story moves through surrounding Ohio locations. The town is therefore both settlement and gameplay hub.

articleSections.title: Scope and interpretation
paragraphs: Repeatable contracts do not imply an endless literal sequence in archival chronology; named introductions and regional function are the safer claims.

entities.summary: A super mutant warlord who rules part of Burning Springs and anchors its released storyline.
entities.description: A super mutant warlord who rules part of Burning Springs and anchors its released storyline.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: Bethesda's official preview and release notes describe the Rust King as a ruthless ruler associated with arena combat in post-nuclear Ohio. This establishes the character's released narrative role.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: The update begins a storyline in which players seek an audience and prove themselves. Detailed motives and route consequences require in-game extraction beyond release-note metadata.

articleSections.title: Scope and interpretation
paragraphs: The record intentionally remains more cautious than older researched subjects: official promotional description supports the role, while deeper claim-level primary locators remain a research gap.

entities.summary: The Mojave Express courier whose attempted murder and recovered delivery place them at the centre of the 2281 Mojave conflict.
entities.description: The Mojave Express courier whose attempted murder and recovered delivery place them at the centre of the 2281 Mojave conflict.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: The Courier is a player-defined role with no fixed name, sex or allegiance. Benny intercepts the delivery of the Platinum Chip at Goodsprings, shoots the courier and leaves them buried; rescue creates the investigation that opens Fallout: New Vegas.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: Following Benny connects the Courier to Robert House, the NCR, Caesar's Legion and Yes Man. The recovered Chip can activate House's securitron network, but its political use depends entirely on the route selected.

articleSections.title: Outcomes and interpretation
paragraphs: The Courier must influence the Second Battle of Hoover Dam, yet the victor and subsequent government are mutually exclusive outcomes. DLC histories add prior work along the Divide without defining every aspect of the protagonist's earlier life.

entities.summary: The Chairmen leader who steals the Platinum Chip in an attempt to displace Robert House.
entities.description: The Chairmen leader who steals the Platinum Chip in an attempt to displace Robert House.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: Benny leads the Chairmen at the Tops while secretly planning to escape House's control. He learns of the Chip delivery, recruits Great Khan assistance and attacks the Courier outside Goodsprings.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: His scheme depends on Yes Man, a reprogrammed securitron able to explain and execute an independent takeover. The Courier can confront Benny in New Vegas or after he flees toward the Fort.

articleSections.title: Outcomes and interpretation
paragraphs: Benny can die at several points or briefly escape, but his attempted coup is the fixed event that destabilises House's plan.

entities.summary: A pre-War data-storage device carrying upgrades and access codes for Robert House's securitron network.
entities.description: A pre-War data-storage device carrying upgrades and access codes for Robert House's securitron network.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: House arranges the Chip as a durable physical carrier for software intended to reach Las Vegas before the Great War. The nuclear exchange prevents its delivery, leaving the device outside his control for two centuries.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: In 2281 House hires couriers to conceal the true delivery. Benny steals it, Caesar seeks to control access beneath the Fort, and the Courier determines whether its upgrades serve House, an independent Vegas or neither.

articleSections.title: Outcomes and interpretation
paragraphs: The Chip's function is explicit; its final use is conditional. It should not be reduced to currency or treated as evidence that House's political predictions are automatically correct.

entities.summary: Robert House's sealed casino, command centre and life-support facility on the New Vegas Strip.
entities.description: Robert House's sealed casino, command centre and life-support facility on the New Vegas Strip.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: The Lucky 38 survives the Great War within House's defensive network and remains closed while he governs indirectly. Its computers, securitron links and medical systems sustain his authority.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: The Courier is the first invited visitor in generations and becomes House's primary field agent or potential usurper. Access to the penthouse and control room reveals the human body behind his public screen identity.

articleSections.title: Outcomes and interpretation
paragraphs: Its control can change through the main quest, but the structure's role as House's command centre precedes every ending.

entities.summary: The fortified casino district at the political and economic centre of New Vegas.
entities.description: The fortified casino district at the political and economic centre of New Vegas.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: House's securitrons secure the Strip and install three tribal groups as casino families. Walls and credit checks separate it from poorer Freeside while NCR visitors support its economy.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: The Lucky 38, Tops, Gomorrah and Ultra-Luxe embody House's managed order and the families' competing interests. Embassy, military and tourist traffic link the district to NCR expansion.

articleSections.title: Outcomes and interpretation
paragraphs: Several institutions may change leadership, but the archive treats those endings as conditional rather than rewriting the district's 2281 starting state.

entities.summary: A reprogrammed securitron intelligence able to support an independent takeover of New Vegas.
entities.description: A reprogrammed securitron intelligence able to support an independent takeover of New Vegas.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: Yes Man is modified to disclose information and obey anyone who gives him orders. Benny uses that constraint to build a coup plan outside House's network.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: After Benny's defeat, the Courier can use Yes Man to contact factions, access the Lucky 38 and direct the upgraded securitron army. This is the independent main-quest route rather than an unavoidable event.

articleSections.title: Outcomes and interpretation
paragraphs: The ending describes further changes to his software, but the political consequences vary. His helpful presentation should not obscure the breadth of control placed in one command interface.

entities.summary: A small Mojave settlement where the Courier is rescued after Benny's attack.
entities.description: A small Mojave settlement where the Courier is rescued after Benny's attack.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: Goodsprings is built around a spring, saloon, general store and former schoolhouse. Its residents provide a grounded local community away from the main powers contesting Hoover Dam.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: Victor and Doc Mitchell recover the Courier, making the town the starting point of the pursuit. A dispute with the Powder Gangers creates an early conditional test of allegiance.

articleSections.title: Outcomes and interpretation
paragraphs: The town may survive, submit or suffer according to player action. Its role in the Courier's rescue is fixed.

entities.summary: A crowded district outside the Strip shaped by poverty, migration and competing local organisations.
entities.description: A crowded district outside the Strip shaped by poverty, migration and competing local organisations.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: Freeside grew around the Strip's northern approaches but remains outside House's casino enclave. Refugees, traders and impoverished residents share limited water, food and security.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: The Kings exercise neighbourhood authority while the Followers operate the Old Mormon Fort. NCR relief activity and military presence can produce cooperation or street violence.

articleSections.title: Outcomes and interpretation
paragraphs: Quest outcomes alter relations, yet the district's structural inequality and institutional plurality are established independently of the Courier.

entities.summary: A Freeside organisation modelled on the style and surviving cultural traces of a pre-War entertainer.
entities.description: A Freeside organisation modelled on the style and surviving cultural traces of a pre-War entertainer.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: The Kings occupy a former impersonation school and transform its fragments into dress, speech and group identity. They combine gang authority with local assistance and protection.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: Their leader, the King, negotiates with NCR newcomers while internal members can provoke violence. The Courier may secure reconciliation or deepen conflict.

articleSections.title: Outcomes and interpretation
paragraphs: The organisation is not a historical continuation of the entertainer's life; it is a post-War culture built from incomplete material remains.

entities.summary: An isolationist community descended from Vault 34 residents and based at Nellis Air Force Base.
entities.description: An isolationist community descended from Vault 34 residents and based at Nellis Air Force Base.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: The Boomers maintain artillery, aviation knowledge and a guarded oral history after leaving Vault 34. Their bombardment of approaches preserves autonomy but limits understanding of outsiders.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: The Courier can earn trust by helping Nellis families and recovering a bomber, after which the community may intervene at Hoover Dam. Their support is negotiated rather than automatic.

articleSections.title: Outcomes and interpretation
paragraphs: Participation in the battle is conditional. The community's technical culture and isolation are established before that choice.

entities.summary: The pre-War air base occupied and restored by the Boomers.
entities.description: The pre-War air base occupied and restored by the Boomers.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: Nellis provides bunkers, workshops, runways and artillery that allow the Boomers to remain independent. The community adapts military infrastructure into a multi-generational home.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: Its school, generators and museum show social life beyond weapons. The perimeter bombardment signals the cost of entering without permission.

articleSections.title: Outcomes and interpretation
paragraphs: The Courier can repair infrastructure and alter external relations, but its approximate real-world basis should not be mistaken for exact in-game spatial scale.

entities.summary: The NCR's principal military headquarters in the New Vegas area.
entities.description: The NCR's principal military headquarters in the New Vegas area.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: The NCR converts the former airport into barracks, logistics and command facilities supporting its Mojave occupation. Its scale also exposes supply pressure and administrative friction.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: Officers confront intelligence leaks, Fiend attacks and overstretched deployments while the Strip draws personnel away from duty. The site ties distant republican institutions to daily occupation.

articleSections.title: Outcomes and interpretation
paragraphs: Several investigations have branching outcomes, but the base's 2281 operational role is fixed.

entities.summary: Caesar's principal Mojave camp on the east bank of the Colorado River.
entities.description: Caesar's principal Mojave camp on the east bank of the Colorado River.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: The Fort concentrates Legion command, slaves, soldiers and captured material opposite Hoover Dam. Its tents and earthworks express an army organised for a further western campaign.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: Caesar receives the Courier there and reveals the securitron bunker beneath the camp. Leadership tensions involving Caesar, Lanius and Lucius become visible behind the Legion's public discipline.

articleSections.title: Outcomes and interpretation
paragraphs: The camp's survival and ruler vary after the finale. Its use as the 2281 invasion headquarters is explicit.

entities.summary: An NCR post at a former resort near Lake Mead and headquarters of the First Recon-associated defensive line.
entities.description: An NCR post at a former resort near Lake Mead and headquarters of the First Recon-associated defensive line.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: Camp Golf became important during the First Battle of Hoover Dam, when Chief Hanlon used misinformation and prepared positions to draw Legion forces into a trap at Boulder City.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: By 2281 the resort houses Rangers and poorly performing troops, illustrating uneven readiness inside a large occupation force. Hanlon's crisis of confidence shapes a conditional investigation.

articleSections.title: Outcomes and interpretation
paragraphs: The Courier can alter personnel and Hanlon's fate; the camp's battle history remains source-backed.

entities.summary: A Mojave town destroyed by Legion forces as a staged lesson in punishment.
entities.description: A Mojave town destroyed by Legion forces as a staged lesson in punishment.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: Before the attack, Nipton's economy combined trade, gambling and prostitution while local officials dealt opportunistically with several groups. Vulpes Inculta exploits that corruption to gather victims.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: The Legion kills, enslaves or cripples residents and forces captives through a lottery. The Courier encounters the aftermath, not a preventable local battle.

articleSections.title: Outcomes and interpretation
paragraphs: Legion interpretation of the massacre is an ideological source statement; the deaths and destruction are observable facts.

entities.summary: A pre-War solar power station contested by the NCR and Mojave Brotherhood.
entities.description: A pre-War solar power station contested by the NCR and Mojave Brotherhood.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: Elder Elijah commits the Mojave chapter to holding HELIOS One for its advanced systems. NCR pressure and the Brotherhood's refusal to withdraw produce a costly defeat that drives the chapter into Hidden Valley.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: In 2281 NCR technicians struggle to operate the plant while the Courier can redirect power and uncover the ARCHIMEDES system. Those choices have different beneficiaries.

articleSections.title: Outcomes and interpretation
paragraphs: The site's technical capabilities are source-backed, but activating or assigning them is conditional.

entities.summary: A former Mojave Brotherhood elder whose pursuit of advanced technology culminates at the Sierra Madre.
entities.description: A former Mojave Brotherhood elder whose pursuit of advanced technology culminates at the Sierra Madre.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: Elijah prioritises transformative technologies over the survival and consent of his chapter. His decision to hold HELIOS One contributes to defeat, after which he disappears and McNamara takes command.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: At Big MT he exploits or imprisons other travellers, then uses bomb collars to force a team into the Sierra Madre casino. He seeks its vending systems, holograms and cloud as tools of coercive power.

articleSections.title: Outcomes and interpretation
paragraphs: The Courier can trap or kill him, and his claims about rebuilding conceal an explicitly authoritarian project.

entities.summary: A Mojave Brotherhood scribe who questions her chapter's isolation and acts as a field procurer.
entities.description: A Mojave Brotherhood scribe who questions her chapter's isolation and acts as a field procurer.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: Veronica grows up within the Brotherhood and is mentored by Elijah. As a procurement specialist she travels outside Hidden Valley, giving her direct experience of changes the sealed chapter avoids.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: She asks the Courier to help demonstrate alternative strategies to the elder. The response can lead her to remain, attempt departure or face violence connected to her contacts.

articleSections.title: Outcomes and interpretation
paragraphs: Her future is conditional, but her critique documents a genuine internal Brotherhood debate rather than an external caricature.

entities.summary: A sealed pre-War resort whose toxic cloud, holographic security and obsessive histories frame Dead Money.
entities.description: A sealed pre-War resort whose toxic cloud, holographic security and obsessive histories frame Dead Money.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: Frederick Sinclair built the Sierra Madre as both refuge and monument, while wartime shortcuts and personal betrayal compromised its systems before opening day. The Great War sealed guests and staff into catastrophe.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: Elijah abducts the Courier and three companions to breach its vault. Radios, collars, ghost people and the cloud turn movement through the resort into coerced survival.

articleSections.title: Outcomes and interpretation
paragraphs: Companion survival and the vault outcome vary. The location's pre-War collapse and Elijah's operation are established across every route.

entities.summary: A vast pre-War research complex isolated inside a mountain crater and governed by the Think Tank.
entities.description: A vast pre-War research complex isolated inside a mountain crater and governed by the Think Tank.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: Big Mountain Research and Development Center hosted projects whose technical ambition routinely outran consent and safety. Its facilities connect robotics, cybernetics, biological weapons and technologies later encountered elsewhere.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: After the War, scientists preserved as brains in mobile units become the Think Tank, while Dr. Mobius confines them through deception. The Courier's forced surgery initiates Old World Blues.

articleSections.title: Outcomes and interpretation
paragraphs: Many experiments have independent histories and should not be conflated. The Courier may change leadership, but the complex's research legacy remains.

entities.summary: The post-War robotic brain collective governing Big MT's central research dome.
entities.description: The post-War robotic brain collective governing Big MT's central research dome.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: The Think Tank consists of pre-War scientists whose brains and personalities survive in mechanical apparatus. Isolation, memory alteration and institutional culture magnify their detachment from the harm caused by experiments.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: They remove the Courier's brain, spine and heart and direct recovery efforts against Mobius. Recovered evidence reveals that Mobius's supposed threat also keeps them from escaping into the wider wasteland.

articleSections.title: Outcomes and interpretation
paragraphs: Their fate depends on dialogue and violence. Scientific description does not validate their ethical self-assessment.

entities.summary: A former Legion frumentarius and courier who confronts the player character through the history of the Divide.
entities.description: A former Legion frumentarius and courier who confronts the player character through the history of the Divide.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: Ulysses was born among the Twisted Hairs, whose identity was destroyed after incorporation into Caesar's Legion. He later served as scout and agent, finding Hoover Dam and encountering communities beyond the Legion.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: He attributes the Divide's destruction to a package carried by the Courier and constructs a confrontation around nations, symbols and responsibility. His account supplies essential testimony but is also a deliberate accusation.

articleSections.title: Outcomes and interpretation
paragraphs: Dialogue can change whether he survives and how the missiles are handled. The archive distinguishes his witnessed history from his broader political conclusions.

entities.summary: A devastated trade community and missile landscape central to Lonesome Road.
entities.description: A devastated trade community and missile landscape central to Lonesome Road.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: A settlement grew along routes linking west and east and developed a flag-based identity. NCR movement and Legion interest made it strategically significant before buried warheads detonated.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: Ulysses says a device delivered by the Courier triggered the launch network, destroying the community and creating marked men and violent storms. Environmental and automated records support the catastrophe, while intent and full prior knowledge remain distinct questions.

articleSections.title: Outcomes and interpretation
paragraphs: The Courier's final missile decision is conditional. The earlier destruction is backstory, though mediated partly through Ulysses's testimony.

entities.summary: NCR and Legion survivors transformed by the Divide and held together by shared conditions.
entities.description: NCR and Legion survivors transformed by the Divide and held together by shared conditions.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: The missile disaster strips and irradiates soldiers from opposing armies while storms and the Divide's environment sustain their altered bodies. Cut off from former commands, they form hostile mixed groups.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: Their presence demonstrates that the catastrophe does not simply preserve the NCR–Legion boundary. Ulysses uses them as part of his account of symbols erased by disaster.

articleSections.title: Outcomes and interpretation
paragraphs: They are not a unified political successor state, and their exact future after the Courier's passage is unresolved.

entities.summary: A subterranean mutated population encountered in the Divide.
entities.description: A subterranean mutated population encountered in the Divide.

articleSections.title: Background
paragraphs: Tunnelers occupy caves and buried infrastructure exposed by the Divide's destruction. They hunt in groups and threaten marked men, deathclaws and travellers.

articleSections.title: Historical role
paragraphs: Ulysses predicts that they may spread into the Mojave. That prediction is a source claim about a possible future, not a completed historical event.
